title: INSS authorizes payroll‑deduction loans without facial biometrics for retirees
seoTitle: INSS allows payroll loans without facial biometrics
subtitle: Retirees and pensioners can now obtain payroll‑deduction credit via the Meu INSS app
excerpt: Retirees and pensioners without facial biometrics in federal databases regain access to payroll‑deduction loans authorized through the Meu INSS app.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Retirees and pensioners of the National Institute of Social Security (INSS) who do not have facial biometric records in federal databases now have the possibility to contract payroll‑deduction loans.

The authorization can be done directly through the Meu INSS app, using access via registration data.

With this measure, the INSS expands the availability of payroll‑deduction credit for those who were previously hindered by the lack of facial biometrics.

With information from Agência Brasil.
